incident.title: Checkout writes fail only on the new release
incident.description: HTTP 500 responses began after the 14:00 deployment. Reads remain healthy, but creating a checkout fails in the production environment.

evidence.content: {"sha":"1111111111111111111111111111111111111111","message":"Read checkout coupon_code during order creation; migration exists locally but deploy manifest omits 20260801_add_coupon_code.sql","author":"mina","timestamp":"2026-08-01T13:42:00Z"}
Production write failures after a deploy can indicate application code referencing a column before its migration was applied. Compare the deployment manifest with migration history.

ground_truth: The release referenced coupon_code while its production migration was omitted.

incident.title: Refund totals exceed submitted requests
incident.description: A small set of customers received two refunds after workers were restarted during a provider slowdown. Request logs show no duplicate client submissions.

evidence.content: {"sha":"2222222222222222222222222222222222222222","message":"Retry refund jobs after lease timeout; remove idempotency key because provider rejects repeated headers","author":"omar","timestamp":"2026-08-01T15:58:00Z"}
A worker restart can replay leased jobs. Refund side effects require a stable idempotency key across attempts.

ground_truth: Removing the stable idempotency key made lease retries duplicate refund side effects.

incident.title: Catalog latency rises with result size
incident.description: The catalog endpoint remains correct but p95 latency grows almost linearly with the number of products returned. Database CPU increased after a serializer cleanup.

evidence.content: {"number":303,"title":"Simplify product serializer","description":"Load inventory inside serialize_product so each response uses fresh availability. The list endpoint calls this once per product.","state":"closed","merged_at":"2026-08-02T08:40:00Z"}
Latency proportional to result count with elevated database CPU is characteristic of per-row inventory queries in serialization.

ground_truth: PR 303 introduced an N+1 inventory query in the product serializer.

incident.title: Valid sessions rejected in production only
incident.description: Login succeeds and returns a token, but API requests immediately receive 401 in production. Staging is unaffected after the same application build.

evidence.content: {"sha":"4444444444444444444444444444444444444444","message":"Rename AUTH_ISSUER to AUTH_PUBLIC_ISSUER in production template; API still reads AUTH_ISSUER","author":"sara","timestamp":"2026-08-02T10:31:00Z"}
When one environment rejects otherwise valid tokens, compare issuer and audience values consumed by the API against deployed environment variable names.

ground_truth: The production template renamed the issuer variable without updating the API consumer.

incident.title: Payment requests amplify during provider slowness
incident.description: During a 20-second provider degradation, outbound payment traffic tripled and checkout workers saturated. Normal traffic returned when the provider recovered.

evidence.content: {"number":505,"title":"Make payment retries more responsive","description":"Retry timeouts immediately up to five times; remove jitter and the total retry deadline.","state":"closed","merged_at":"2026-08-02T17:50:00Z"}
External API retries need exponential backoff, jitter, and a total deadline. Immediate retries amplify a slow dependency.

ground_truth: PR 505 replaced bounded backoff with immediate unbounded retries, causing amplification.

incident.title: Reports include records outside the selected account
incident.description: The new report export returns the expected rows plus a small number belonging to other accounts. Interactive report views remain correctly scoped.

evidence.content: {"sha":"6666666666666666666666666666666666666666","message":"Reuse report export query outside request context; remove tenant_id predicate because RLS is enabled in web sessions","author":"li","timestamp":"2026-08-03T06:55:00Z"}
Offline export workers use a privileged database role and must apply tenant_id explicitly; web-session RLS does not protect worker queries.

ground_truth: The export worker removed explicit tenant scoping while running with a role that bypasses web RLS.

incident.title: New tasks never become ready
incident.description: The deployment completed, but every new task fails readiness checks while the process itself reports that startup succeeded. Rolling back restores service.

evidence.content: {"sha":"7777777777777777777777777777777777777777","message":"Move API to port 8081; deployment readiness probe still targets 8080","author":"nora","timestamp":"2026-08-03T11:37:00Z"}
If a process starts but never becomes ready, compare its listening port and path with the deployed readiness probe before changing application logic.

ground_truth: The application port changed while the deployment readiness probe retained the old port.

incident.title: Ordinary document uploads are rejected
incident.description: PDF uploads around 2 MB began returning validation errors after a security hardening release. Tiny text attachments continue to succeed.

evidence.content: {"number":808,"title":"Centralize upload limits","description":"Convert configured megabytes to bytes. The validator multiplies by 1024 while the config loader already converted the value to kilobytes.","state":"closed","merged_at":"2026-08-03T15:10:00Z"}
Upload size limits are stored in bytes at runtime. Unit conversion must occur exactly once at the configuration boundary.

ground_truth: PR 808 double-converted upload limit units, shrinking the effective limit.

incident.title: API throttles low-volume customers
incident.description: Customers sending fewer than ten requests per minute receive 429 responses. The issue began after rate-limit configuration was consolidated.

evidence.content: {"sha":"9999999999999999999999999999999999999999","message":"Share rate limit window config; pass RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS to limiter expecting seconds","author":"ivan","timestamp":"2026-08-04T07:48:00Z"}
Unexpected low-volume throttling often follows a window-unit mismatch. Confirm whether the limiter expects seconds or milliseconds.

ground_truth: The limiter received a millisecond window value through an API that expects seconds.

incident.title: Search traffic still reaches retired cluster
incident.description: A deployment intended to move search traffic to the new cluster succeeded, but production continues querying the old cluster. Local and staging use the new endpoint.

evidence.content: {"sha":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","message":"Rename SEARCH_URL to SEARCH_ENDPOINT in application; production secret manifest still exports SEARCH_URL","author":"aya","timestamp":"2026-08-04T10:02:00Z"}
Configuration renames can leave production secret manifests stale. Applications may then fall back to a deprecated default endpoint.

ground_truth: The application variable was renamed without updating the production secret manifest.
